Torchlight Infinite Vorax Gameplay Overview - SHOULD You Play It? Is It Worth It?
In this Fextralife video, we're going to be discussing why now might be a great time to try out Torchlight Infinite, the latest entry in the beloved dungeon crawler series. The game has received a ton of changes since its release in October of 2022 and season 11 Vorax just released on January 15th bringing even more overhauls and additions to the title. Whether you're a brand new player of returning one, there's lots to check out in this video.
